articles.title: Altcoins lead crypto declines as Asian stocks drop; bitcoin little changed since midnight
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell to just above $80,000 as South Korea’s Kospi plunged 8%, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 2.2% and all but six CoinDesk 100 members declined.

articles.title: Bitcoin wilts as Fed rate uncertainty weighs. Kospi plunges 8%
articles.snippet: Bets on an October Fed rate hike briefly spiked to nearly 50% after Wednesday’s inflation report, but have since cooled.

articles.title: U.S. September CPI comes in hot, sending bitcoin sharply lower
articles.snippet: The news could put multiple rate hikes by the Federal Reserve back into play.

articles.title: Ex-Trump crypto adviser profited after helping pass stablecoin bill: WSJ
articles.snippet: The Wall Street Journal reported that a company co-founded by Bo Hines benefited from the passage of the GENIUS stablecoin bill.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips under $80K after US PPI gains most in four years
articles.snippet: BTC buyers attempted to defend $80,000 support after September US producer inflation overshot expectations by 100 basis points for the largest monthly gain since March 2022
